recipe_version.title: Uruguayan Chivito Steak Sandwiches with Ham, Bacon, Mozzarella, and Egg
recipe_version.description: Thin seared beef steaks layered on toasted rolls with ham, crisp bacon, melted mozzarella, a pan-fried egg, mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, and sliced green olives.

ingredients.name: bacon

ingredients.display_name: deli ham whose label lists pork, water, salt, sugar, sodium phosphate, and sodium nitrite

ingredients.name: rolls
ingredients.display_name: soft sandwich rolls whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, sugar, salt, and oil

ingredients.name: mayonnaise

ingredients.name: green olives
ingredients.display_name: pitted green olives whose label lists olives, water, salt, and lactic acid

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the sirloin into 4 thin steaks, pound each between plastic wrap to 1/4 inch, and season with the salt and pepper. Slice the tomato and olives and split the rolls.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.body: Cook the bacon in the 12-inch skillet over medium in 2 batches until crisp, about 6 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels and pour off all but 1 tbsp fat.

steps.title: Toast the rolls
steps.body: Toast the cut sides of the rolls in the skillet over medium until golden, about 2 minutes per batch, and spread with mayonnaise.

steps.title: Sear the steaks
steps.body: Raise the heat to medium-high. Sear 2 steaks about 90 seconds, flip, top each with a ham slice and a mozzarella slice, cover, and cook until the cheese melts and the steak is 145 F, about 2 minutes. Move to the large plate and repeat (2 batches).

steps.title: Pan-fried eggs
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Crack the 4 eggs into the skillet and pan-fry until the whites set, about 3 minutes (cover for firmer yolks).

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Layer each roll with lettuce, tomato, a steak with its ham and cheese, 2 bacon slices, an egg, and olives. Close and serve.
